title: Eric Crittenden - All-Weather Portfolios with Trend Following (S3E7)

reader_summary.headline: This podcast is for informational purposes only.
reader_summary.overview: This podcast is for informational purposes only. and should not be relied upon as a basis for investment decisions. My guest is Eric Crittenden, founder and chief investment officer of Standpoint Funds. Eric has spent his career with trend following strategies, first at Blackstar, where he managed to fund of funds, then at Longboard.

thesis: The speaker recounts two formative college experiences that introduced him to the dangers of survivorship bias and the tendency of the industry to curve-fit history. He explains how his first project revealed that back-tests on surviving instruments ignored bankrupt stocks, leading him to realize the entire industry was plagued by cherry-picked versions of history rather than actual history.
